message.content: It depends on traffic and how many stops you make, but under normal conditions the drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles (about 380–400 mi via I‑5 or US‑101) takes roughly **6–7 hours**. In heavy traffic or if you’re taking scenic routes, it could easily stretch to 8–9 hours.
